mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in a month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for 2 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of economic expansion, a rise in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases > 2% QoQ during economic expansion and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
